webllm.advancedNote: For advanced use only. This requires an MLC/WebLLM-compiled model URL and a matching model_lib wasm, not an arbitrary Hugging Face repo.
webllm.modelIdPlaceholder: Optional. Derived from the model URL when blank.

fireworks.title: Fireworks AI
fireworks.subtitle: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Pick a curated model and apply it to an agent surface.
fireworks.encryptedNote: Stored encrypted at rest with userCrypto.

huggingface.noSavedModels: No saved models yet. Load a compatible Hugging Face repo once and it will stay here for quick reuse.
huggingface.noDownloadedModels: No downloaded Hugging Face models were found in this browser yet.
huggingface.runtimeNote: Runs locally in this browser with WebGPU. Only Transformers.js-compatible repos with ONNX assets can load, and the browser caches the downloaded files after the first load.
huggingface.providerIntro: Hugging Face ONNX runs the model locally in this browser through Transformers.js on WebGPU. Enter any compatible repo id here or pick a saved model, then load it directly from this dialog. First load will download the browser assets and show progress below.
